text.description_html:
Deltana WBHDCL9, Modern Left Corner HD Wire Basket

Stylish as it is functional, Deltana's HD Left Corner Wire Basket is perfect for homes with modern decor. The WBHDCL9 HD Wire Basket is useful to store anything from hand soap to shampoo, or even books or spices. The shelf is designed to utilize often wasted corner space. It easily mounts to the wall and is made out of solid brass. It is available in satin nickel or polished chrome finishes; and it is made with the attention to high quality that is expected of Deltana. Never have storage issues again!

Also Available:
Deltana WBHDUC9 9 Inch HD Universal Corner Bathroom Basket
Deltana WBHDCR9 9 Inch HD Right Corner Bathroom Basket

Shop more of the Deltana Wire Baskets

Features and Specifications of the WBHDCL9 Solid Brass Modern Corner Shelf:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Shelf Length (left side): 9-1/4" x 4-7/8"
  • Shelf Length (right side): 8-5/8" x 4-3/8"
  • Height: 2-1/8"
  • Deltana WBHDCL9 9" HD Left Corner Basket Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 basket, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
